info.title: AZMARO API
info.description: REST API for the AZMARO fragrance storefront. All responses use the envelope `{ success, message, data, error?, meta? }`. Cookie-authenticated mutating requests must send the `X-CSRF-Token` header (get it from `GET /api/v1/auth/csrf`).

post.description: Send an `Idempotency-Key` header (any unique string per checkout attempt) – retries with the same key return the original order instead of creating a duplicate. For online methods the response `payment.clientAction` tells the frontend how to complete payment (e.g. open Razorpay Checkout). Without a configured provider the order is a clearly-marked test order with payment NOT_COLLECTED.

post.description: Call with the three values Razorpay Checkout returns in its success handler. Webhooks remain the authoritative source and reconcile any mismatch.

post.summary: Start a new payment attempt for an order awaiting payment
post.description: Send an `Idempotency-Key` header to make retries safe.

Razorpay: configure the webhook URL `/api/v1/payments/webhooks/razorpay` with events payment.authorized, payment.captured, payment.failed, order.paid, refund.processed. The `X-Razorpay-Signature` header is verified (HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body). Replayed events (same `X-Razorpay-Event-Id`) are acknowledged and ignored.
Returns courier data only when a courier is connected; otherwise status UNAVAILABLE with isTest=true. No estimates are invented.

Authenticated with the shared secret in the `X-Courier-Token` header (COURIER_WEBHOOK_SECRET). Body: { awb, status, description?, location?, occurredAt?, eventId? }. Events are de-duplicated by eventId.
